personality_one_liner: Calm, trustworthy, and distraction-free offline expense ledger with tactile precision and instant glanceability.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm, safe-area conscious, touch targets >= 44x44pt

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of total spent filtered by month/week, category spend breakdown with dropdown filters, transaction list, and quick actions.

states.empty: Clean minimal empty state with 'No spends yet' prompt and quick add CTA

screens.layout: Sticky header with app title and PDF export button. Total spend card with week/month segmented toggle. Category breakdown card with dropdown filter and progress bars. Transaction history list with date grouping, amount in ₹, category badge, and notes. Sticky Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right with 3-option action sheet (Add Payment, Add Category, Download PDF).

screens.name: AddPaymentModal
screens.purpose: Modal sheet to add a new spend amount, choose category, select date (DD/MM/YYYY), and add optional note.

states.error: Validation error for missing amount or category

screens.layout: Bottom sheet or full-screen modal with clean form fields, large numeric amount keypad input, category selector chips/dropdown, date picker, and note input. Sticky primary CTA 'Save Spend'.

screens.name: CategoryManagerModal
screens.purpose: Manage categories: add new, edit name/color, or delete with spend transfer destination prompt.
screens.layout: List of default and custom categories with action buttons for edit and delete. Transfer modal when deleting a category that has active spends.

screens.name: PDFExportModal
screens.purpose: Export spend data to PDF with custom date range selection, summary totals, and itemized lists.

states.empty: No data in selected date range

screens.layout: Date range picker (from date to date), summary preview card, and 'Generate & Share PDF' primary action button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a fully functional offline React Native Ledger app for Android using local AsyncStorage. Strictly follow currency ₹, date format DD/MM/YYYY, categories (Food, Transport, Bills, Shopping, Health, Entertainment, Other), PDF export via expo-print / expo-sharing, category deletion with spend transfer prompt, undo deletion snackbar, edit payments, and include 'Made by Subhasish' in the footer. Ensure all UI components adhere to iOS-Native Clean personality with 44x44pt touch targets and correct light surface contrast.
